title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description: Guy Fieri dives into Kenyan curried goat and Moroccan lamb in Tallahassee, Fla.; a Chicago spot serves up béchamel arancini and a deli in Gainesville, Fla., brings the heat with salt-and-pepper smoky sausages.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description: Guy is setting his sights on seafood and creative comfort; Stephanie Izard's Chicago joint puts out elevated diner fare like Szechuan biscuit sandwiches; in Florida, Guy finds gangster gumbo, off-the-hook étouffée and a righteous Reuben.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description: Guy Fieri dives into a world of cultural cuisine with indigenous recipes; fry bread and pozole in Phoenix, Ariz.; authentic Argentine specialties in Boulder, Colo.; a kabob spot in Memphis, Tenn., marinates meats with Ethiopian flavor.

title: Carnival Eats
description: Noah visits the Norfolk County Fair in Ontario, Canada and enjoys the Thanksgiving bowl and butter bacon poutine; the Columbia County Fair in S.C. serves gator nuggets with swamp sauce, the hog on a log and angel and devil dogs.

title: Carnival Eats
description: Noah visits the Eastern Carolina Agricultural Fair in Florence, S.C. and samples Calzagna and a deep-fried Philly blossom; Noah arrives at the Mountain Mandarin Festival in Auburn, Calif., and savors the Atomic Habanero Tots and The Big Yum.

title: Get A Beautiful New Smile in 24 Hours

title: Delicious Miss Brown

title: Delicious Miss Brown
description: Kardea Brown is keeping Thanksgiving intimate with a special meal for Ma and Grandma; Grandma always brings the turkey, so Kardea is taking on the sides, with candied yams, oyster stuffing and cranberry custard pie for dessert.

title: Delicious Miss Brown
description: Kardea Brown treats her friend to some Southern home cooking; the meal includes lemon and garlic baked chicken, country wild rice with sausage and collard greens with tomatoes; for dessert, Kardea makes upside down peach cornbread cake.

title: Delicious Miss Brown
description: Kardea Brown invites her best friends over for Friendsgiving, and she's in charge of the turkey and side dishes; deviled crabs in the shell, a Cajun butter spatchcock turkey, fried cabbage and sweet potato stuffed cornbread.

title: Pioneer Woman's Ultimate Thanksgiving
description: Pioneer Woman Ree Drummond cooks up the ultimate three-day countdown to a frontier-style Thanksgiving dinner with delicious make-ahead dishes.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description: Thanksgiving turkey gets cooked and portioned out in advance; doctored-up dressing and gussied-up gravy; roasted sprouts and onions; spiked cranberry sauce and herby butter dinner rolls; chocolate marshmallow pumpkin pie.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description: Ree Drummond puts a spin on everyone's favorite Thanksgiving sides; she makes over colorful spicy maple roasted carrots, macaroni-inspired baked cheesy O's, a shortcut cheesy brown butter focaccia and classic broccoli casserole.

title: The Kitchen
description: The Kitchen hosts throw a Friendsgiving party that kicks off with toasted mulled cider margaritas, and baked brie with cranberry chutney and toasted almonds; roasted turkey and root vegetables and mini pumpkin spice latte puddings for dessert.

title: The Kitchen
description: The Kitchen goes big on Thanksgiving flavors with mashup favorites! Katie Lee Biegel makes Spinach Artichoke Dip Stuffed Mushrooms, Jeff Mauro preps Jalapeños and Cranberry Stuffed Turkey Breast and Sunny Anderson bakes Adult Pecan Pie Brownie Bars.

title: Best Bake Ever With Danielle Sepsy

description: Danielle Sepsy shares two items from her bakery, The Hungry Gnome; she makes cherry vanilla bean scones, then bakes blueberry crumb muffins topped with a buttery streusel.

description: Guy Fieri is back to host a holiday showdown in a Winner's Wonderland! All-new teams of 32 superstar chefs create sweet and savory delights in hopes of sleighing the competition, winning the title, scoring $100,000 and delivering big bucks for charity.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description: Five cookie makers begin with mix-and-match Christmas character cookies; then the bakers must craft 3D cookie displays inspired by holiday music where they must incorporate ingredients from classic Christmas songs, like pears, figs and chestnuts.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description: Five cookie makers put their heart and soul into crafting cookies that celebrate Christmas weddings; the competition heats up as the cookie makers create 3D Christmas trees inspired by plants found deep in the dessert.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description: Five talented cookie makers are tasked with creating Christmas cross-stitch cookies; the crafting continues as the bakers combine the beauty of a wreath with the fun of a Christmas character in one massive, 3-D cookie display.

title: Holiday Wars

title: Holiday Wars
description: The six remaining teams face off as Jeff challenges them to envision a hobby for Santa's reindeer to enjoy when they aren't pulling the sleigh; Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira judge the designs before flying one team home.

title: Holiday Wars
description: Jeff Mauro challenges the five remaining teams to create a woodland creature that is throwing an ugly sweater party for all its forest friends; at the end of the festive fiesta, judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira eliminate one more team.

title: Holiday Wars
description: Jeff Mauro and the Holiday Wars time machine send the remaining four teams back in time; each group must create a Santa from a specific period in history; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide who will move forward.
